discovery: min-hand-pips, first eligible equal-pip connector-vs-unrelated choice per deal, at least 6 exact hidden allocations
splitMethod: Sort allocation indices by 32-bit mix(dealSeed XOR imul(index+1,0x9e3779b9)); mix: x=imul(x^(x>>>16),0x7feb352d); x=imul(x^(x>>>15),0x846ca68b); return x^(x>>>16). First floor(n/2) are fold 0, remainder fold 1. Each fold tested once, other fold used for training.
trainDecision: Maximize train finish-first, tie break lower mean focal remainder, then higher minus-finish frequency, then lexical action key.
passDecision: Choose connector iff exact analytic next-player pass probability is strictly greater, otherwise unrelated; primary summary excludes pass ties.
regret: Test oracle is max of two actual outcomes in each held-out world, not a deployable policy. Test regret is its advantage over chosen action; train choices are never selected on held-out outcomes.
limitations: Small exact world counts (>=6) and folds of 3-11 worlds, selection and bot-policy dependence, no opponent pass history, branch-opening assumption, unassigned block winner, exploratory position-normal confidence intervals. Training/test worlds share visible positions and are not independent deals.
exactNextAction: Repeat on independent seeds 2200000..2350000, restrict >=10 worlds, assess stability of CV-vs-pass; then include history-conditioned posterior and >=3 candidate actions.
